lines.text: Come on. My workshop's this way.
You have a WORKSHOP?
...Is that a jar of grubs?
For science.
And this is how I fixed your machine.
Wait. That's... MY handwriting.
I built that? ...I built that! Why'd I ever stop?
You stopped building. So I started.
Look, chat. One square on the page... is one block out here. That's scale.
Mom says homework. School night.
Page twelve. You'll figure it out...
You did the first time.
...Just me, then.
Alone. In the woods. Where the boar... lives.
You kinda bussin'... you kinda bussin'...
Nope. Nope nope nope.
Page twelve...
Ooh. Fancy. A garden gate... with a lever.
Chat... somebody's been tearing pages out of my book.
Chat... batten down the hatches!

rows.text: a garden gate with a lever
